HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Questions from Gus Group, manager of Lantern Street Angels, with answers from Jane
Doe, April 5, 2011
Q. How will the group invest? A (Gus Group). Members invest through one vehicle,
Lantern Street Seed I, LLC.
Q. What is the use of funds? A. About 55 percent goes to sales, 30 percent to a head
of support, and the rest to hosting.
Q. Who else is investing? A. Two individuals: Angie Angel and Sam Seed.
Q. When do you expect a priced round? A. We expect to start seed fund talks in May
2011.
Q. What happens if no round closes before the notes mature? A. The holders of a
majority of the principal may extend them or ask for repayment.
Q. Is any dispute or claim pending against the company? A. None.
